title: AI Local Lead Finder
tagline: Find high-intent B2B leads from public business signals.
businessOutcomes: A steady list of new local prospects without manual searching.
summary: Searches public sources such as Google business listings, Yelp, TripAdvisor, reviews, websites, and directories to identify businesses that match a target ICP and show potential pain signals.
businessProblem: B2B sellers waste hours manually searching Google Maps, Yelp, and directories to build prospect lists — and still miss businesses with visible pain signals like unanswered negative reviews or outdated websites.
outcome: A scored prospect list filtered by geography, industry, and ICP criteria — each lead tagged with pain signals, contact info, and a one-line reason they're worth pursuing.
expectedOutcomes: A scored prospect list filtered by geography, industry, and ICP criteria — each lead tagged with pain signals, contact info, and a one-line reason they're worth pursuing.
whoItsFor: B2B agencies, SaaS companies, and local service providers selling to other businesses who need net-new prospect lists without expensive data subscriptions.
aiInputs: ICP definition: industry, geography, employee size proxy, revenue signals
Google Places / Yelp search parameters (category, radius, keyword)
Review text and ratings from listing pages
Website URL and basic page content if available
Exclusion list of existing customers or CRM accounts
aiOutputs: Filtered prospect list with business name, address, phone, website
Pain signal tags (low rating, no website, stale reviews, unanswered complaints)
Suggested outreach angle per lead based on detected signals
noCodeTools: Outscraper Google Maps export → ChatGPT scoring in a Google Sheet
Apify Google Maps scraper → Zapier → HubSpot import with GPT summary
Clay.com enrichment table with Places + Yelp + AI columns
lowCodeTools: n8n: Places API search → Yelp enrichment → OpenAI pain scoring → Sheets
Google Sheets + Apps Script + Places API + Claude for ICP filtering
Make.com: Outscraper webhook → OpenAI → HubSpot contact create
customBuildStack: Node.js service querying Google Places Text Search API
Yelp Fusion business match for cross-validation
Outscraper/Apify for bulk listing + review extraction
OpenAI structured output for ICP scoring and pain tagging
HubSpot or Salesforce bulk import endpoint
implementationSteps: Define ICP: target industries, cities, business size proxies, and disqualifiers
Set up Google Places API key and Yelp Fusion app with rate limit handling
Build search queries per geography — e.g., 'commercial cleaning' in Austin TX
Pull reviews and website URLs; flag pain signals with a scoring rubric
Run AI pass to score fit and draft one-line outreach angles
Deduplicate against CRM before import; review top 20% manually before outreach
systemBehavior: Runs on schedule (weekly) or on-demand per territory — not real-time
Read-only on public sources — never contacts businesses automatically
Respects API rate limits with batching and backoff
Excludes businesses already in CRM or on do-not-contact list
Logs search parameters and result counts for reproducibility
risks: Scraping TripAdvisor or directories may violate platform terms — prefer official APIs where available
Public listing data can be stale — verify phone and website before outreach
Cold outreach to scraped leads must comply with CAN-SPAM and local regulations
Over-broad ICP definitions produce low-quality lists that waste sales time
